journey.name: Profile and settings — identity, copy pubky, sign out
journey.description: Own profile, the settings screen (identity info, copy pubky) and sign-out back to onboarding. Run LAST — it ends the session. Requires a signed-in session.

actions.action: Launch the Echo app and verify the Home screen is shown
Open the Profile tab from the bottom tab bar
Verify the profile screen shows the user's identity (name or truncated pubky)
Verify the Settings screen is shown with an Identity section (truncated pubky, homeserver) and a "Sign out" row
Tap the copy control next to the pubky and verify no crash occurs
Verify the app returns to the onboarding screen with the "Sign in with Pubky Ring" button
